```sql
WITH nature_reserve AS (
  SELECT 
    park_name,
    geometry
  FROM 
    parks
  WHERE 
    park_name ILIKE '%nature reserve%' 
    AND ST_Intersects(geometry::geometry, (SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-87.4781, 37.9763), 4326)::geography))
    AND addr_city = 'Evansville'
    AND addr_state = 'Indiana'
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, true, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM nature_reserve)) AS clipped_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM nature_reserve))
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT park_name FROM nature_reserve) AS reserve_name,
  MAX((clipped_rast).val) AS max_elevation
FROM 
  clipped_dem;
```
